newsitem.title: UK: European vegoils end mixed but little moved.
newsitem.headline: European vegoils end mixed but little moved.

text.p: European vegetable oils ended mixed but little moved from midday levels or from Monday's close.
Selling levels had been pressured downwards slightly by the lack of clear direction from the Malaysian palm oil futures and the absence of fresh market-moving news.
The palm oil sector closed mostly unchanged to $5 lower, apart from Aug/Sep crude palm oil which closed at $522.50, down $7.50.
During the afternoon session the only reported trade in the palm oil sector was for RBD oil, with $502.50 paid for both Jun and Aug/Sep.
The soft oils finished one guilder down to 0.25 guilder higher. They appeared to have largely ignored the firmer stance seen on early Chicago soybean oil future trading.
Coconut oil closed unchanged to $2.50 lower having traded Aug/Sep material at $630 and Oct/Nov at $627.50.
